'''Jyn Freila''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after listening to one of [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] speeches. She flew an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] and led her own [[Jyn Freila's squadron|squadron]] until it was mostly destroyed during a [[Raid on a quadanium steel shipment|raid]] on a [[Quadanium steel/Legends|quadanium steel]] shipment. After the raid, she was promoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and given command of [[Keff Base]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
